title: Purportedly AI-Generated Video of Tigers at Barasat Madrasa in West Bengal Reportedly Causes Panic and Student Absenteeism

behaviors.text: A purportedly AI-generated video circulated on Facebook allegedly showing tigers roaming the campus of a person in Barasat, West Bengal.
The video was reportedly created by a geography teacher using AI tools and allegedly led to panic among parents and students, with a sharp drop in attendance.
